newsitem.title: GREECE: Aktor says project orderbook at 70bln drs.
newsitem.headline: Aktor says project orderbook at 70bln drs.

text.p: Aktor construction management told shareholders during the annual meeting that the company's orderbook of uncompleted projects stood close to 70 billion drachmas.
Forecasts for this year see turnover rising 30 percent to 17 billion drachmas from 13 billion in 1995. Pre-tax earnings will grow 19 percent to 3.0 billion drachmas from 2.52 billion in 1996.
Aktor which leads the Attiki Odos consortium which has been awarded the Elefsina-Stavros-Spata highway said the project was budgeted at 48 billion drachmas.
Managing director Leonidas Bobolas told shareholders the firm would stick to its high payout policy. It will pay a 1996 dividend per share of 120 drachmas.
Aktor will also capitalise reserves of 1.0 billion drachmas and will issue bonus shares -- 10 bonus shares for every 20 held. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
